projects.title: Retail E-Commerce Platform
projects.shortDescription: A scalable multi-vendor e-commerce platform with real-time inventory management and AI-powered product recommendations.
projects.description:
We designed and built a comprehensive e-commerce platform for a regional retail group, replacing their legacy system with a modern, scalable architecture. The platform supports multiple vendors, real-time inventory synchronisation, and integrates with their existing ERP system.

The solution includes a customer-facing storefront, a vendor management portal, and an operations dashboard — all built on a unified technology stack.
projects.challenge: The client's existing e-commerce system was built on legacy technology that could not scale to support their growth ambitions. The system experienced frequent outages during peak periods and lacked the vendor management capabilities required for their marketplace expansion.
projects.solution: We architected a cloud-native solution on AWS using Next.js for the storefront, a Node.js microservices backend, and PostgreSQL for structured data with Redis caching. The platform was designed for horizontal scaling and deployed using Docker containers managed through AWS ECS.
results: 99.9% uptime achieved in the first three months post-launch
Page load times reduced from 6s to under 1.2s
Platform scaled to support 3× peak traffic without manual intervention
Vendor onboarding time reduced from 2 weeks to 48 hours

projects.title: Healthcare Patient Portal
projects.shortDescription: A secure, compliance-aligned patient management portal enabling digital appointment booking, health records access, and teleconsultation.
projects.description:
A regional healthcare network required a modern patient-facing portal to replace their fragmented phone and paper-based processes. The portal enables patients to book appointments, access health records, and conduct video consultations with clinicians.

Security and compliance were the primary design constraints, requiring careful architecture of data handling, access controls, and audit logging.
projects.challenge: Patient data security and regulatory compliance were non-negotiable requirements. The existing systems used disparate databases with inconsistent access controls, creating compliance risks and a poor patient experience.
projects.solution: We designed a security-first architecture with end-to-end encryption, role-based access control, and comprehensive audit logging. The teleconsultation feature was built using WebRTC with TURN server infrastructure for reliable video connectivity.
results: Patient digital adoption reached 68% within 90 days
No-show rates reduced by 34% through automated reminders
Administration time per appointment reduced by 40%
Security audit passed with zero critical findings

projects.title: Cloud Migration & DevOps Transformation
projects.shortDescription: End-to-end cloud migration and DevOps implementation for a manufacturing group, reducing infrastructure costs and increasing deployment frequency.
projects.description:
A manufacturing group with operations across multiple sites operated entirely on on-premises infrastructure, creating reliability risks and limiting their ability to scale and iterate quickly. We led a phased cloud migration to AWS alongside a full DevOps transformation.

The engagement covered infrastructure assessment, application refactoring, cloud architecture design, CI/CD pipeline implementation, and team enablement.
projects.challenge: Over-reliance on on-premises infrastructure created single points of failure and prevented rapid iteration. Deployments required manual coordination and took days to complete, limiting the team's ability to respond to business needs.
projects.solution: We designed a phased migration strategy, starting with stateless applications and progressing to databases with minimal downtime. Terraform managed infrastructure-as-code, and GitHub Actions pipelines replaced all manual deployment processes.
results: Infrastructure costs reduced by 38% in the first year
Deployment frequency increased from monthly to multiple times per week
Mean time to recovery reduced from 4 hours to under 20 minutes
Zero unplanned production outages in 8 months post-migration

projects.title: AI-Powered Document Processing System
projects.shortDescription: An intelligent document processing pipeline using machine learning to automate extraction, classification, and routing of business documents.
projects.description:
A financial services firm processed thousands of documents daily using manual review teams. The high volume, inconsistent quality, and compliance sensitivity made this a critical operational bottleneck.

We designed and built an AI-powered document processing pipeline to automate extraction, classification, and workflow routing, integrating with their existing document management platform and providing a human-in-the-loop review interface.
projects.challenge: Manual document processing was slow, error-prone, and difficult to scale. Compliance requirements meant every document needed accurate extraction and proper audit trails, creating pressure on review teams and increasing processing costs.
projects.solution: We built a multi-stage ML pipeline using AWS Textract for OCR and custom classification models for document routing. A human-in-the-loop interface allows review teams to handle edge cases while the system learns from corrections.
results: 85% of documents processed automatically without human review
Processing time reduced from 48 hours to under 4 hours
Error rate reduced from 3.2% to 0.4%
Annual processing costs reduced by over 60%

projects.title: Mobile Banking Application
projects.shortDescription: A feature-rich cross-platform mobile banking application with biometric authentication, real-time notifications, and personal finance tools.
projects.description:
A fintech startup required a complete mobile banking application to launch their digital banking product. The application needed to meet stringent security and regulatory requirements while delivering a consumer-grade user experience.

We designed and built the cross-platform mobile application, backend API, and core banking integration layer from the ground up.
projects.challenge: Building a banking application requires navigating complex regulatory requirements while delivering a frictionless user experience. The client needed a cross-platform solution that could be maintained and extended by a small team.
projects.solution: Flutter was chosen for cross-platform development, allowing a single codebase for iOS and Android. We implemented biometric authentication, end-to-end encryption, and a comprehensive audit logging system. The backend was built on a Node.js API with PostgreSQL for transactional data.
results: Launched on both iOS and Android simultaneously
4.7-star rating in app stores within the first month
Biometric authentication adoption reached 91%
App store approval achieved on the first submission
